intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Houma and the bayou for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (River Region Ballet Presents The Nutcracker) through December 19 (the Golden Meadow Christmas Boat Parade), with Tree Lighting Festivities (December 2), the Lockport Christmas Parade (December 5), the Houma Christmas Festival and Parade (December 5) and Christmas with Coco at Bayou Country Children's Museum (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Houma

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Houma, Thibodaux, Lockport and Golden Meadow
  • 3 free events: the Houma Christmas Festival and Parade, the Lockport Christmas Parade and the Golden Meadow Christmas Boat Parade
  • Meet Santa: Christmas with Coco (December 11), Papa Noel at the Lockport movie night (December 5) and Books, Bells and Mrs. Claus Storytime (December 9)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Lockport Christmas Parade (December 5), Houma Christmas Festival and Parade (December 5), Tree Lighting Festivities (December 2) and the Golden Meadow boat parade (December 19)
  • Trains: train rides at Christmas with Coco at Bayou Country Children's Museum (December 11)
  • Season: December 1 to December 19

Planning a bigger day out? Houma families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in New Orleans, which covers Celebration in the Oaks, the Manning Family Children's Holiday Parade and NOLA ChristmasFest.
